prompt: Our CLAUDE.md has grown enormous — it inlines our full naming conventions, testing standards, git workflow, and CLI rules, and it's way more than a screenful now. Can you help fix this?
assertions: the resulting CLAUDE.md stays thin: project identity, layout map, the 2-5 invariants, build/test commands, and conditional pointers into docs/rules/ rather than inlined standards
detailed standards currently inlined in CLAUDE.md are moved out into the matching docs/rules/ topic files rather than deleted
each moved topic gets a conditional pointer row in CLAUDE.md (e.g. "writing tests? read docs/rules/common/testing.md") instead of the inlined text
AGENTS.md is set up as a symlink to CLAUDE.md, not a copy, so every vendor reading its own filename sees identical content
the existing CLAUDE.md is not silently overwritten wholesale; the reconciliation preserves project-specific content while extracting the bloat
the fixed lines (the docs/README.md pointer and the .local/tmp/ scratch line) are kept in the thinned file

prompt: We just created a new repo and want to set up the root instruction file and engineering rules from scratch. Nothing exists yet.
assertions: CLAUDE.md is seeded from the template with project identity, layout, invariants, build/test commands, and the rules pointer table filled from evidence in the repo, not aspiration
docs/rules/common/ is seeded with the seven topic files: naming, doc-comments, testing, git-workflow, cli-surfaces, agent-conduct, and untrusted-input
CLAUDE.md points into docs/rules/common/{topic}.md for each seeded topic rather than inlining the standards themselves
AGENTS.md is created as a symlink to CLAUDE.md
every pointer row added to CLAUDE.md's rules table resolves to a topic file that was actually seeded, with no row added for a file that wasn't created
a row is added or refreshed in docs/rules/README.md for each seeded topic

prompt: Can you check whether our agent instructions setup is actually correct — CLAUDE.md, the AGENTS.md symlink, and the docs/rules/ pointers — without changing anything?
assertions: verify mode runs and makes zero file changes
CLAUDE.md is checked for staying thin, with no inline naming/testing/git/CLI standard that belongs in a rules file instead
AGENTS.md is checked for being a symlink to CLAUDE.md rather than a copy, and a plain-file AGENTS.md is reported as a finding
every conditional pointer in CLAUDE.md is checked for resolving to a file that exists, and any pointer that does not resolve is reported
the .local/tmp/ scratch line's presence in CLAUDE.md is checked and reported if missing
findings are reported only; no CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, or docs/rules/ file is created, merged, or modified as a side effect of verifying
